picks.editorial_note: NSF's $1.5B X-Labs initiative adds a dedicated funding call for AI for Physical Systems, signaling a major federal bet on AI-driven breakthroughs across the physical sciences.
picks.title: NSF announces 3 additional topics as part of the NSF X-Labs initiative to pursue generational breakthrough science and technology efforts

picks.editorial_note: A $15M gift from the OpenAI Foundation to UCSF's OpenADMET Consortium will build open pharmacokinetic datasets to train AI drug-behavior models, a rare direct industry-to-academia investment in open science infrastructure.
picks.title: A Gift to Help Scientists Predict How Drugs Behave in the Body

picks.editorial_note: SRI's $26.5M ARPA-H award to build an AI 'co-pilot' for rural medical care tackles a real healthcare access gap and demonstrates federal appetite for deploying AI directly into underserved clinical settings.
picks.title: Reuters covers SRI's work in the ARPA-H-funded PARADIGM program - SRI

picks.editorial_note: NSF's new ELEGANT program aims to translate low-dimensional semiconductor research into U.S. manufacturing, addressing the hardware bottleneck that underpins future AI compute capacity.
picks.title: NSF invests in translating low-dimensional semiconductor technologies to establish U.S. leadership in microelectronics

picks.editorial_note: Rutgers and RWJBarnabas Health's AWS-powered Innovation Hub is a concrete academic-clinical-industry partnership pairing cloud AI infrastructure with medical education and research at scale.
picks.title: Rutgers and RWJBarnabas Health to Launch Innovation Hub, Powered by Amazon Web Services

picks.editorial_note: Science Tokyo's protein language model unifying sequence and 3D structure data represents a genuine methodological advance for mapping evolutionary relationships across the protein universe.
picks.title: Uniting sequence and structure to map the protein universe | Science Tokyo

picks.editorial_note: UCLA's 'physical AI' approach—where nanowire networks physically function as neural networks—points toward a fundamentally new, energy-efficient hardware paradigm for on-device AI.
picks.title: Toward physical AI: When the hardware becomes the neural network

picks.editorial_note: Integrating EPFL/ETH Zurich's open-source Apertus model into Proton's Lumo assistant exposes a fully transparent, privacy-focused LLM to tens of millions of users, a notable proof point for open-source AI at consumer scale.
picks.title: Apertus partners with Proton's Lumo AI assistant

picks.editorial_note: A DOE Genesis Mission-funded project at UNR applying AI to nuclear waste safety-case evidence could directly influence regulatory review processes for hazardous waste management.
picks.title: AI project reviews nuclear waste safety-case evidence

picks.editorial_note: ASU's $5M NSF-funded PARAPET project builds shared national cyberinfrastructure for privacy-preserving data sharing across institutions, addressing a key barrier to collaborative AI research.
picks.title: $5M NSF award to enhance data protections for users nationwide
